title: Area Sales Manager (Pernambuco, Bahia State)
description:
Ecorobotix SA. creates innovative robotic solutions that reduce the negative ecological impact of modern agriculture. We have developed an AI-based ultra-high precision spot spraying technology that drastically reduces the amount of chemicals used in crop fields while keeping costs competitive. The technology is currently deployed on our tractor towed ARA machine. By joining our talented and dynamic team, you will contribute to a more sustainable, environment-friendly agriculture in an innovative scale-up at the cutting edge of technology. We are a revolutionary organization with a great work environment that supports creativity through self-motivation.


To pursue our growth in Brazil, we are hiring an experienced entrepreneurial mind based in Pernambuco, Bahia State for an:


Area Sales Manager


General objective of the role

As an Area Sales Manager of the Ecorobotix SA. Team, you will be responsible for managing and expanding the sales of agricultural machinery within a designated region. The role involves overseeing existing dealer relationships, optimizing dealer performance, and driving new business opportunities by identifying future dealers and customers as well as driving revenue growth. The Area Sales Manager will work closely with dealers to ensure product availability, support, and training, ensuring the company’s agricultural machinery is effectively marketed and sold. This position requires a leader with a deep understanding of market dynamics, strong leadership skills, and the ability to foster a results-oriented sales culture within the region.


Reporting lines and interactions

This role reports directly to the Commercial Director. Internally, you will closely collaborate with other members of the Sales team and other teams of Ecorobotix. Externally, you will interact with dealers, farmers, partners, associations, trade shows, Agronomists, and CCA’s.


A day in the life of an Area Sales Manager

The Area Sales Manager will travel across the designated territory to visit key accounts, meet new prospects, and support dealer partners. Whether you're pulling into a grower's yard or a dealership lot, you're the face of a cutting-edge ag-tech company that's reshaping the future of precision spraying.


You will showcase how our high-precision sprayer delivers real ROI: less chemical waste, more targeted application, and better yields. You walk growers through the technology— highlighting features like variable rate spraying and intelligent targeting—while grounding every conversation in real-world impact. You sit down and dig into the potential customer’s specific challenges and help them see how the product fits into their operation. You're not just selling equipment;
you're helping solve problems.


“You’re part field representative, part storyteller, part strategist. You’re a trusted advisor selling value, not just hardware.”


Key Responsibilities

  • Identify and prospect new customers across Brazil, managing all communication and driving the sales process through to contract signature.
  • Engage with customers to understand their needs and provide tailored solutions, ensuring strong order generation and relationship development.
  • Assess customer solvency, share pricing information, negotiate terms, and suggest improvements to optimize pricing strategies.
  • Provide training and ongoing support to partners, while identifying opportunities for expanding and strengthening the partner network.
  • Actively participate in industry fairs, customer demos, and events to increase visibility and drive engagement in the region.
  • Foster collaboration and support within the distributor network to drive sales and enhance product reach.
  • Create compelling content in collaboration with the marketing team to support campaigns and enhance brand presence.


Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in Sales and/or Agronomy, or related field.
  • 10+ years of experience in sales and hands-on experience in agriculture, ag-tech, or precision equipment.
  • Willingness to travel domestically in Brazil.

Must-Have

  • Experience in Ag-tech or chemical distribution.
  • Knowledge in Agronomy related to weeding in field crops.


Your Assets

  • Excellent communication and leadership skills, willingness to build relationships with customers.
  • Exceptional written and verbal presentation skills, with clear & consistent communication.
  • High degree of independence, reliability, and spirit of initiative.
  • Driven individual with systematic, goal-oriented working methods.
  • Computer skills. Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and CRM tools.
  • Strong organizational and multi-tasking skills
  • Team-player

title: Presales Solutions Architect
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. This role is responsible for coordinating multidisciplinary teams to develop compelling, compliant, and competitive proposals in response to RFPs, RFIs, and other customer solicitations, both in public and private sectors.

You must have:


  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, IT, or related field. Master’s degree is a plus.
  • 5+ years of experience in solution design, bid/proposal management, sales support, or pre-sales roles.
  • Experience in managed services with exposure to emerging tech and AMS (Application Managed Services, CI/CD, SRE)

Good to have:


  • Experience in AI,Gen AI, ML (MS Co-pilot, Google Gemini, Open AI, LLM), legacy modernization, customer experience and digital transformation
  • Strategic thinking and commercial acumen.
  • High attention to detail and commitment to quality.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to influence and motivate stakeholders.
  • Resilience and adaptability in high-pressure environments.
  • Proactive mindset with continuous improvement focus.

title: Account Manager Team Lead

SHEIN is a global online fashion and lifestyle retailer, offering SHEIN branded apparel and products from global network of vendors, all at affordable prices. This role ensures operational excellence across campaigns, assortments, and portfolio management, while maximizing revenue opportunities and elevating product quality and commercial performance within SHEIN’s BR marketplace. As a people leader, the Team Lead also supports team development, fosters high performance, and ensures alignment with business goals and marketplace strategy.

  • Negotiate strategies to leverage seller performance.
  • Prepare reports about assisted sellers to leadership in order to execute defined strategies.

  • Propose and execute category/seller-growth projects.
  • Be responsible for supporting the training and onboarding of new team members, acting as a technical reference and contributing to the team’s ongoing development.


Qualifications:

  • Experience in e-commerce/marketplaces
  • Prior experience in Project Management is a plus
  • Prior experience in fashion market is a plus
  • Excellent communication skills — written and verbal — in Portuguese and English (Advanced/Fluent)

At SHEIN, we believe that diversity is the force that drives innovation. We are committed to creating an environment where all voices are heard, valued and respected. All our vacancies are inclusive for people with disabilities, women, black people, LGBTQIAPN+ community and all types of diversity.

title: Especialista De Arquitetura De Dados & Ia
description:
Descrição da vaga

O Itaú é a marca mais valiosa do Brasil, a melhor empresa para trabalhar segundo o Great Place to Work e o maior banco da América Latina. Nós impactamos diariamente mais de 98 milhões de clientes em 18 países.


Somos feitos de pessoas e acreditamos que ter um time com pluralidade de origens, culturas, crenças, experiências, raças, deficiências, gêneros, orientações afetivo-sexuais e gerações ampliam as perspectivas e contribuem para um clima de respeito e valorização das diferenças.


Nossa equipe de Arquitetura de Solução em IA é responsável por definir e acompanhar as frentes de Inteligência Artificial para padronizar uso de IA no Itaú. Cada solução é pensada para tornar as interações simples, rápidas e seguras, garantindo que as aplicações ofereçam fluidez e consistência. Trabalhamos para que a arquitetura, os Agentes e os serviços de IA habilitem jornadas generativas intuitivas, escaláveis e resilientes, conectando tecnologia e as necessidades para entregar valor real aos itubers e clientes.


Estamos buscando profissionais que dominem e possuam forte acuidade arquitetural, que tenha uma forte atuação hands-on em IA, domínio de DDD e design de plataformas que habilitem reuso e evolução contínua, com visão estratégica e capacidade de inovação.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

Estamos buscando uma pessoa para a posição de Especialista de Arquitetura de Dados & IA , que queira se desenvolver e aprender, compartilhar, colaborar e inovar, entregando valor para todos os nossos clientes.


Nessa função você vai:


Arquitetura e Plataforma

  • Definir e evoluir a arquitetura de IA para o Banco (alta escala, reuso, baixo acoplamento, personalizável), com observabilidade e tolerância a falhas de ponta a ponta.
  • Liderar decisões sobre tecnologias de IA Generativa guiado por trade-offs claros entre latência, consistência, capacidade de experimentação, custo e time-to-market.
  • Desenhar e governar soluções de IA e Agentes Generativos (aggregation, routing, orchestration, caching, personalization, feature flags, A/B) que sirvam múltiplos agentes trazendo jornadas generativas estáveis, versionamento, backward compatibility e observabilidade por domínio.
  • Direcionar o reuso dos capabilities/domain services (crm, auth, AI Models, CC, limites, PaaS), com bounded contexts bem definidos, APIs consistentes, catálogo de eventos e SDKs reutilizáveis.


Excelência de Arquitetura de Soluções

  • Tomar decisões de arquitetura usando DDD (ubiquitous language, aggregates, domain events, anticorruption layer) e arquitetura hexagonal (ports & adapters).
  • Implantar boas práticas: idempotência, backpressure, circuit breakers, retry with jitter, dead-letter queues, saga/outbox, blue/green & canary, zero-downtime migrations, security by design.
  • Garantir observabilidade abrangente (logs estruturados, tracing distribuído), SLOs por serviço e acompanhamento dos postmortems para aplicar ações de melhoria.
  • Otimizar custos na AWS (right-sizing, autoscaling, spot/ savings plans, cache e storage tiers, redução de chatter entre serviços).


Liderança Técnica

  • Definir north star architecture e roadmap evolutivo;
    alinhar múltiplos timesàs estratégias de Jornadas e Plataformas.
  • Mentorar arquitetas(os), engenheiras(os) sêniores, elevar o cdigo-foco e a qualidade técnica org-wide;
    conduzir design reviewse tech forums.
  • Colaborar com Produto e Design para equilibrar viabilidade técnica e valor de negocio, documentando trade-offs e riscos.
  • Atuar e liderar pelo exemplo, de forma hands-on no desenvolvimento de agentes, participando de revisões de codigo, testes e documentação.
  • Participar de rotações de suporte, acompanhamento, deploys fora do horário respondendo a incidentes quando necessário.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Experiência solida e comprovada na definição e desenvolvimento de soluções de produtos digitais em ambientes complexos.
  • Profundo conhecimento em arquitetura de IA, distribuída, microserviços e tecnologias de cloud.
  • Historico comprovado na entrega de soluções para sistemas de grande escala, com foco em IA, resiliência e custo-benefício.
  • Forte domínio em linguagens backend (python);
    experiência com arquitetura e event-driven.
  • Conhecimento em práticas de CI/CD, arquiteturas de IA e integração com sistemas de alta disponibilidade.
  • Experiência em mentoria técnica, elevando o nível da arquitetura e engenharia em múltiplos times.
  • Boa comunicação para explicar trade-offs técnicos a diferentes stakeholders.
  • IA aplicada no dia a dia.
  • Desejável certificação Cloud

title: Estágio Em Controladoria De Projetos
description:
Pronto para criar o seu impacto positivo? Então junte-se à Tractebel, parte do Grupo ENGIE, e aos nossos 5600 especialistas apaixonados em todo o mundo, motivados por moldar um mundo mais sustentável todos os dias. É a sua oportunidade de fazer parte da aventura do século: acelerar a transição energética - ao mesmo tempo que melhora a vida das pessoas, através de projetos com significado. Está pronto para fazer a diferença? Então, estamos animados para conhecer você!



O que oferecemos


  • A Tractebel é mais do que um local de trabalho. É a sua oportunidade de evoluir ao lado de especialistas em projetos com impacto global . É um ambiente baseado no espírito de equipe, onde você pode atingir o seu potencial máximo.   • Entre o primeiro dia útil do ano e a última sexta-feira antes do carnaval, a empresa adota a jornada especial de verão . Você poderá usufruir de uma jornada reduzida às sextas-feiras, mediante compensação.
  • Para celebrarmos momentos especiais e simplesmente nos divertirmos, realizamos ações em datas comemorativas, presenteamos você no seu aniversário, festejamos juntos em nossa confraternização de fim de ano e muito mais.



A sua missão


Como Estagiário(a) da área de Controladoria de Projetos, você contribuirá para a nossa missão de construirmos juntos um futuro neutro em carbono todos os dias.


As suas principais responsabilidades


  • Auxiliar no controle e organização de documentos e contratos de clientes e subcontratados, acompanhando os saldos e atualizações pertinentes;
  • Apoiar o monitoramento dos controles internos da área, contribuindo para o cumprimento de procedimentos e prazos estabelecidos;
  • Participar da elaboração de relatórios e emissão de documentos relacionados à Controladoria de Projetos;
  • Dar suporte às rotinas operacionais da área, garantindo agilidade e precisão nos processos;
  • Colaborar nos processos de abertura e encerramento de projetos, incluindo a criação e atualização de status de centros de custo no sistema;
  • Interagir com outras áreas da empresa para tratar de assuntos financeiros relacionados aos projetos, promovendo alinhamento e integração;
  • Prestar suporteem auditorias internas e externas, contribuindo com informações e documentação necessária.


Gostaríamos de ser contactados por pessoas com


  • Cursando graduação em Administração, Ciências Contábeis e/ou Economia;
  • Conhecimento emPacote Office;
  • Interesse pela área de Controladoria de Projetos;
  • Conhecimento deSistemas integrados, preferencialmente SAP.


Quem somos


As nossas prioridades são as pessoas, a ética, a segurança e a sustentabilidade. Com a Tractebel, você pode ter um impacto positivo nos objetivos globais de neutralizar as emissões de carbono. O nosso maior ativo são os nossos empregados e a diversidade é a nossa força!


Saiba mais sobre a Tractebel , as nossas atividades e o porquê de se deve juntar a nós!


Na ENGIE, todo talento tem um papel a desempenhar na aceleração da transição energética. Faça a diferença e desfrute de uma experiência profissional gratificante. Encare desafios empolgantes e construa uma trajetória de carreira que reflita quem você é.


Junte-se a nós e faça parte da aventura do século!


Todas as nossas vagas estão disponíveis, também, para candidatos com deficiência ou beneficiários reabilitados pelo INSS.


Candidate-se agora mesmo!

title: Content Safety Operations Specialist
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a Content Safety Operations Specialist to support the Brazil market, ensuring high standards of content quality and safety across the platform. In this role, you will monitor content trends, identify risks, and collaborate closely with global teams to improve policies and enforcement strategies.


You will act as a key local point of contact, bringing insights about Brazilian culture, user behavior, and regulatory developments to support the continuous evolution of content safety operations.


Responsibilities

  • Continuously review and assess content quality and appropriateness within the Brazil market, identifying risks, anomalies, and emerging trends.
  • Produce regular reports on content quality, trending topics, and potential safety risks.
  • Act as the local point of contact for safety operations, maintaining close communication with global teams.
  • Share insights on local culture, user behavior, and policy updates to support decision-making.
  • Support the development and optimization of content safety strategies and moderation guidelines tailored to the Brazil market.
  • Monitor regulatory developments related to online content in Brazil and support the handling of escalations and compliance requirements.


Requirements

  • Fluent Portuguese and Chinese (Mandarin) to support communication with global stakeholders.
  • 2+ years of experience in content safety, content moderation, Trust & Safety, or related fields.
  • Strong understanding of Brazilian culture, social trends, and online behavior, with the ability to identify sensitive content.
  • Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills, with experience working in distributed or international teams.


Nice to Have

  • Knowledge of English (written and spoken), with the ability to collaborate with global teams.
  • Experience working with policy development, moderation guidelines, or regulatory compliance.

title: Area Sales Manager (Santa Catarina State)
description:
Ecorobotix SA. creates innovative robotic solutions that reduce the negative ecological impact of modern agriculture. We have developed an AI-based ultra-high precision spot spraying technology that drastically reduces the amount of chemicals used in crop fields while keeping costs competitive. The technology is currently deployed on our tractor towed ARA machine. By joining our talented and dynamic team, you will contribute to a more sustainable, environment-friendly agriculture in an innovative scale-up at the cutting edge of technology. We are a revolutionary organization with a great work environment that supports creativity through self-motivation.


To pursue our growth in Brazil, we are hiring an experienced entrepreneurial mind based in Santa Catarina State for an:


Area Sales Manager


General objective of the role

As an Area Sales Manager of the Ecorobotix SA. Team, you will be responsible for managing and expanding the sales of agricultural machinery within a designated region. The role involves overseeing existing dealer relationships, optimizing dealer performance, and driving new business opportunities by identifying future dealers and customers as well as driving revenue growth. The Area Sales Manager will work closely with dealers to ensure product availability, support, and training, ensuring the company’s agricultural machinery is effectively marketed and sold. This position requires a leader with a deep understanding of market dynamics, strong leadership skills, and the ability to foster a results-oriented sales culture within the region.


Reporting lines and interactions

This role reports directly to the Commercial Director. Internally, you will closely collaborate with other members of the Sales team and other teams of Ecorobotix. Externally, you will interact with dealers, farmers, partners, associations, trade shows, Agronomists, and CCA’s.


A day in the life of an Area Sales Manager

The Area Sales Manager will travel across the designated territory to visit key accounts, meet new prospects, and support dealer partners. Whether you're pulling into a grower's yard or a dealership lot, you're the face of a cutting-edge ag-tech company that's reshaping the future of precision spraying.


You will showcase how our high-precision sprayer delivers real ROI: less chemical waste, more targeted application, and better yields. You walk growers through the technology— highlighting features like variable rate spraying and intelligent targeting—while grounding every conversation in real-world impact. You sit down and dig into the potential customer’s specific challenges and help them see how the product fits into their operation. You're not just selling equipment;
you're helping solve problems.


“You’re part field representative, part storyteller, part strategist. You’re a trusted advisor selling value, not just hardware.”


Key Responsibilities

  • Identify and prospect new customers across Brazil, managing all communication and driving the sales process through to contract signature.
  • Engage with customers to understand their needs and provide tailored solutions, ensuring strong order generation and relationship development.
  • Assess customer solvency, share pricing information, negotiate terms, and suggest improvements to optimize pricing strategies.
  • Provide training and ongoing support to partners, while identifying opportunities for expanding and strengthening the partner network.
  • Actively participate in industry fairs, customer demos, and events to increase visibility and drive engagement in the region.
  • Foster collaboration and support within the distributor network to drive sales and enhance product reach.
  • Create compelling content in collaboration with the marketing team to support campaigns and enhance brand presence.


Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in Sales and/or Agronomy, or related field.
  • 10+ years of experience in sales and hands-on experience in agriculture, ag-tech, or precision equipment.
  • Willingness to travel domestically in Brazil.

Must-Have

  • Experience in Ag-tech or chemical distribution.
  • Knowledge in Agronomy related to weeding in field crops.


Your Assets

  • Excellent communication and leadership skills, willingness to build relationships with customers.
  • Exceptional written and verbal presentation skills, with clear & consistent communication.
  • High degree of independence, reliability, and spirit of initiative.
  • Driven individual with systematic, goal-oriented working methods.
  • Computer skills. Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and CRM tools.
  • Strong organizational and multi-tasking skills
  • Team-player

Mão na Massa

Queremos alguém próximo da operação, que vá a campo, visite clientes, entenda o ponto de venda, acompanhe a execução e resolva problemas na prática.

Qualidade Não é Negociável

A marca precisa ser bem representada. O profissional deve cuidar da forma como os produtos chegam ao cliente, como são expostos e como a Baggio Café é percebida no mercado.

Espírito Empreendedor

A região Sul ainda tem muito espaço para crescimento. Buscamos alguém com iniciativa para abrir portas, testar caminhos, encontrar oportunidades e construir mercado.

Fazer Diferente

Não buscamos apenas um vendedor que tire pedidos. Queremos alguém que pense em novas formas de desenvolver clientes, melhorar a presença da marca e gerar valor no varejo.

Foco no que Importa

A atuação deve ser objetiva, organizada e voltada para resultado: clientes certos, visitas relevantes, oportunidades reais, bom acompanhamento e crescimento sustentável.

Perfil desejado

Profissional com experiência comercial no varejo alimentar, preferencialmente com atuação em supermercados, empórios, distribuidores ou produtos de consumo. Deve ter perfil prático, organizado, relacional e orientado a resultados, com capacidade de abrir portas, negociar e acompanhar a execução no cliente.

Buscamos um profissional comercial para desenvolver o varejo da Baggio Café na região Sul, com foco em abertura de clientes, crescimento de vendas, execução no ponto de venda e construção de relacionamentos comerciais de longo prazo, sempre alinhado à cultura da Baggio Café: mão na massa, qualidade, empreendedorismo, inovação e foco no que importa.

title: Senior Payments Manager – Brazil
description:
Brazil's payment landscape is complex, fast-moving, and full of opportunity and Antom is building the infrastructure to lead it. We're looking for a Senior Payments Manager who thrives at the intersection of relationship management and operational excellence: someone who can navigate Brazil's financial ecosystem with depth and turn strong partnerships into real payment performance.


What you'll do:


Financial institution & payment partner management

  • Serve as the primary relationship owner for Antom's local payment partners in Brazil, including PIX providers, card acquirers, and Open Finance participants.
  • Maintain and deepen these partnerships to ensure reliability, competitive terms, and long-term strategic alignment.


Payment performance & operations

  • In close collaboration with Antom's internal operations team, monitor and improve SLAs, success rates, and KPIs across local payment methods.
  • Identify performance gaps, coordinate resolution efforts with partners, and drive continuous improvement in payment reliability and conversion.


New payment method onboarding

  • Scout, evaluate, and onboard new local payment methods and financial institution partners that expand Antom's capabilities in Brazil.
  • Lead the end-to-end process from commercial negotiation through to technical go-live.


Cross-functional collaboration

  • Act as Antom's internal Brazil payments subject-matter expert, aligning with Product, Tech, Compliance, and Legal teams to ensure local solutions are properly integrated and optimized.


Regulatory awareness

  • Stay ahead of Banco Central regulations, PIX rulebook updates, Open Finance developments, and card scheme rules.
  • Translate regulatory changes into actionable internal recommendations and partner discussions.


Market intelligence

  • Continuously map the Brazilian payments landscape — tracking competitor capabilities, emerging payment trends, and new fintech entrants to inform Antom's local strategy.


What we're looking for

  • 5–8 years in payments, financial institutions partnerships, or payment operations within a fintech, bank, acquirer, payment processor, or global payments company — with a strong focus on the Brazilian market.
  • Deep, hands-on knowledge of Brazil's payment ecosystem: PIX, card acquiring, and Open Finance, including its regulatory framework and key institutional players.
  • Proven relationship management skills — ability to build and manage senior-level relationships with banks, acquirers, and payment institutions, including navigating complex contractual and operational discussions.
  • Operational mindset — comfortable owning KPIs and SLAs, troubleshooting payment issues with technical and partner teams, and driving measurable performance improvements.
  • Cross-functional communication — able to work across commercial, product, tech, and compliance teams, translating between business needs and technical requirements with ease.
  • Languages: Native Portuguese and full professional English proficiency.


Preferred qualifications

  • Prior experience at a global payments company, international acquirer, or cross-border payment platform operating in Brazil.
  • Existing network across Brazilian financial institutions, acquirers, and Open Finance participants.
  • Familiarity with API-based payment integrations and the technical fundamentals of payment processing.
  • A practical approach to AI tools — using them to automate routine tasks, accelerate analysis, and improve the quality and efficiency of your own work output.
  • MBA or advanced degree in Business, Finance, or a related field.
  • Mandarin is a strong plus.



About Antom

Antom is a leading merchant payment and digitisation services provider under Ant International. We help global merchants and partners accept digital payments, scale their businesses across borders, and deliver seamless checkout experiences to consumers worldwide. In Brazil, we are investing in the local payments ecosystem to become the infrastructure layer of choice for merchants operating in or into the market.

title: Senior Financial Analyst
description:
Senior Financial Analyst

Location: Remote (Brazil)

About Sphise Technologies

Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations. Our trusted partner is expanding its financial operations and is seeking a Senior Financial Analyst to support reporting, billing processes, and revenue operations. This role will play a critical part in ensuring financial accuracy, optimizing workflows, and delivering insights that drive business performance as the organization scales.

Position Overview

We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Senior Financial Analyst to support financial operations, reporting, and billing processes. This role will act as a key partner across Finance, Sales, and Customer Success teams, ensuring alignment between contracts, invoicing, and revenue recognition. The ideal candidate combines strong analytical thinking with hands-on experience in billing, revenue operations, and financial reporting. This role requires both strategic insight and operational execution, contributing to process improvements and supporting the company's financial health and scalability.

What You'll Do:

  • Analyze financial performance, identify trends, and deliver actionable insights to support strategic decision-making
  • Enhance financial reporting, tools, and processes to improve efficiency, accuracy, and scalability
  • Ensure customer contracts are aligned with invoicing terms and revenue recognition policies
  • Prepare and process invoices accurately and in a timely manner, resolving discrepancies when needed
  • Partner with Sales and Customer Success teams to ensure billing accuracy and proper contract implementation
  • Monitor accounts receivable, track outstanding balances, and follow up on overdue payments
  • Maintain accurate billing records and supporting documentation for audits and reporting
  • Contribute to optimizing and streamlining the quote-to-cash process
  • Support financial reporting cycles and assist with audits related to billing and revenue operations
  • Perform ad-hoc financial analysis and support additional finance-related initiatives.

What You Bring:

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field
  • 4–7+ years of experience in financial analysis, billing, accounting, or revenue operations
  • Strong understanding of invoicing processes, revenue recognition principles, and financial reporting
  • Experience working cross-functionally with Sales, Customer Success, and Operations teams
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets
  • Experience with ERP or financial systems is a plus
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills
  • High attention to detail with the ability to meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to translate financial data into clear, actionable insights.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with billing or subscription-based business models
  • Familiarity with quote-to-cash processes
  • Experience supporting audits and compliance processes
  • Background in process optimization and financial systems improvements
  • Experience working in high-growth or scaling organizations.

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation
  • Fully remote work environment
  • Opportunity to work with modern financial systems and tools
  • High-impact role supporting financial strategy and operations
  • Collaborative and fast-growing environment with strong ownership.

Please ensure that your application, including your CV, is submitted in English, as this is a requirement for the recruitment process.

title: Area Sales Manager (Santa Catarina State)
description:
Ecorobotix SA. creates innovative robotic solutions that reduce the negative ecological impact of modern agriculture. We have developed an AI-based ultra-high precision spot spraying technology that drastically reduces the amount of chemicals used in crop fields while keeping costs competitive. The technology is currently deployed on our tractor towed ARA machine. By joining our talented and dynamic team, you will contribute to a more sustainable, environment-friendly agriculture in an innovative scale-up at the cutting edge of technology. We are a revolutionary organization with a great work environment that supports creativity through self-motivation.

To pursue our growth in Brazil, we are hiring an experienced entrepreneurial mind based in Santa Catarina State for an:

Area Sales Manager

General objective of the role

As an Area Sales Manager of the Ecorobotix SA. Team, you will be responsible for managing and expanding the sales of agricultural machinery within a designated region. The role involves overseeing existing dealer relationships, optimizing dealer performance, and driving new business opportunities by identifying future dealers and customers as well as driving revenue growth. The Area Sales Manager will work closely with dealers to ensure product availability, support, and training, ensuring the company's agricultural machinery is effectively marketed and sold. This position requires a leader with a deep understanding of market dynamics, strong leadership skills, and the ability to foster a results-oriented sales culture within the region.

Reporting lines and interactions

This role reports directly to the Commercial Director. Internally, you will closely collaborate with other members of the Sales team and other teams of Ecorobotix. Externally, you will interact with dealers, farmers, partners, associations, trade shows, Agronomists, and CCA's.

A day in the life of an Area Sales Manager

The Area Sales Manager will travel across the designated territory to visit key accounts, meet new prospects, and support dealer partners. Whether you're pulling into a grower's yard or a dealership lot, you're the face of a cutting-edge ag-tech company that's reshaping the future of precision spraying.

You will showcase how our high-precision sprayer delivers real ROI: less chemical waste, more targeted application, and better yields. You walk growers through the technology— highlighting features like variable rate spraying and intelligent targeting—while grounding every conversation in real-world impact. You sit down and dig into the potential customer's specific challenges and help them see how the product fits into their operation. You're not just selling equipment;
you're helping solve problems.

"You're part field representative, part storyteller, part strategist. You're a trusted advisor selling value, not just hardware."

Key Responsibilities

  • Identify and prospect new customers across Brazil, managing all communication and driving the sales process through to contract signature.
  • Engage with customers to understand their needs and provide tailored solutions, ensuring strong order generation and relationship development.
  • Assess customer solvency, share pricing information, negotiate terms, and suggest improvements to optimize pricing strategies.
  • Provide training and ongoing support to partners, while identifying opportunities for expanding and strengthening the partner network.
  • Actively participate in industry fairs, customer demos, and events to increase visibility and drive engagement in the region.
  • Foster collaboration and support within the distributor network to drive sales and enhance product reach.
  • Create compelling content in collaboration with the marketing team to support campaigns and enhance brand presence.

Qualifications

  • Master's degree in Sales and/or Agronomy, or related field.
  • 10+ years of experience in sales and hands-on experience in agriculture, ag-tech, or precision equipment.
  • Willingness to travel domestically in Brazil.

Must-Have

  • Experience in Ag-tech or chemical distribution.
  • Knowledge in Agronomy related to weeding in field crops.

Your Assets

  • Excellent communication and leadership skills, willingness to build relationships with customers.
  • Exceptional written and verbal presentation skills, with clear & consistent communication.
  • High degree of independence, reliability, and spirit of initiative.
  • Driven individual with systematic, goal-oriented working methods.
  • Computer skills. Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and CRM tools.
  • Strong organizational and multi-tasking skills
  • Team-player

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
About

Flatiron is a global remote software development company with engineers located around the world. We unite experts from diverse backgrounds and experiences in a collaborative culture to deliver exceptional products and services for our clients. As a forward-thinking software engineering company, we provide industry-leading solutions to complex problems in both the US and the UK. Operating in a fast-paced, agile environment, we specialize in software consulting for our clients. We offer a stimulating and rewarding environment for our team members. Join us at Flatiron and be a part of a team that is shaping the future of software development.

Job Summary

This is a full-time fully remote working opportunity where you will be working as part of a Scrum team which requires working closely with other software engineers, stakeholders and contributors on the project. Working with respect to the US timezone is a requirement for the position. Attending meetings, being actively involved in the decision making process and collaborating with all of these stakeholders are essential parts of this position.

Responsibilities

  • Design and implement scalable, high-performance full stack applications with a strong emphasis on backend architecture.
  • Lead and contribute to the integration of AI/ML features into products, collaborating closely with data scientists and engineers.
  • Develop robust backend services and APIs using Python or Node.Js (Express, NestJS).
  • Contribute to frontend development using React and modern JavaScript/TypeScript practices.
  • Identify, prioritize, and execute tasks throughout the software development lifecycle.

  • Higher education in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, ideally with a focus on Artificial Intelligence and/or Machine Learning
  • Advanced level of written and oral English proficiency.
  • 4+ years of professional software development experience, with strong backend expertise in Python and/or Node.Js.
  • Proficiency with frontend technologies such as React, Next.Js, and TypeScript.
  • Hands-on experience deploying ML/AI models into production environments.
  • Familiarity with database technologies such as MySQL, MongoDB, or PostgreSQL.

title: Customer Success Analyst
description:
About us:

Closir is a UK-based investor relations (IR) support services provider. For over a decade we have been entrusted by blue chip companies around the world to help them achieve their IR objectives due to our intimate knowledge of the global buy-side, our technological expertise, and our close, long-term partnership approach.

The Closir platform is an all-in-one, web-based solution which makes companies much smarter and more effective, by helping them to achieve their IR objectives intelligently and proactively.

Closir combines all elements of IR, from high-level strategy ("Who's investing in my peers?") to daily workflow ("What topics came up most in my meetings with investors this quarter?") into one intelligent, user-friendly platform which includes the most comprehensive and up-to-date database of buy-side contacts on the market;
proactive outreach tools;
share & peer holder tracking;
customisable reports;
and professional-level support.

Role Overview:

We are looking for a customer-centric, self-driven individual to join our Customer Success team.

You will manage relationships with IR teams at public companies, guiding them from onboarding through to long-term adoption. You'll help clients integrate their data, extract insights, and embed Closir into their day-to-day workflows.

You will work closely with Research and Product teams to ensure high-quality data integration, surface client feedback, and improve the experience on Closir.Com.

Responsibilities:

  • Partner with clients to understand their Investor Relations needs and drive adoption of the Closir platform.
  • Act as a trusted advisor, providing strategic insights and support to senior IR teams.
  • Deliver tailored onboarding, training, and consulting sessions.
  • Collaborate with product and engineering teams to champion client feedback and influence product direction.
  • Build long-lasting relationships that foster retention, growth, and client advocacy.

Qualifications:

  • Background in Investor Relations (in-house or advisory) – you understand the workflows, challenges, and priorities of IR professionals.
  • Experience in consulting, customer success, or client-facing roles where you've advised senior stakeholders.
  • Strong communication and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate complex needs into actionable solutions.
  • Passion for SaaS, fintech, and improving how companies engage with investors.
  • Fluent in English and Spanish

Why Join Us?

  • Work at the intersection of SaaS, finance, and strategy with a fast-growing, global team.
  • Shape the future of investor relations technology.
  • Opportunity to take ownership and make a measurable impact with clients.
  • Collaborative, ambitious, and supportive culture.

If you're excited about helping Investor Relations teams thrive with cutting-edge SaaS solutions, we'd love to hear from you.

This job vacancy is open for candidates based out of Latin America.

title: Senior Payments Manager - Brazil
description:
Brazil's payment landscape is complex, fast-moving, and full of opportunity and Antom is building the infrastructure to lead it. We're looking for a Senior Payments Manager who thrives at the intersection of relationship management and operational excellence: someone who can navigate Brazil's financial ecosystem with depth and turn strong partnerships into real payment performance.

What you'll do:

Financial institution & payment partner management

  • Serve as the primary relationship owner for Antom's local payment partners in Brazil, including PIX providers, card acquirers, and Open Finance participants.
  • Maintain and deepen these partnerships to ensure reliability, competitive terms, and long-term strategic alignment.

Payment performance & operations

  • In close collaboration with Antom's internal operations team, monitor and improve SLAs, success rates, and KPIs across local payment methods.
  • Identify performance gaps, coordinate resolution efforts with partners, and drive continuous improvement in payment reliability and conversion.

New payment method onboarding

  • Scout, evaluate, and onboard new local payment methods and financial institution partners that expand Antom's capabilities in Brazil.
  • Lead the end-to-end process from commercial negotiation through to technical go-live.

Cross-functional collaboration

  • Act as Antom's internal Brazil payments subject-matter expert, aligning with Product, Tech, Compliance, and Legal teams to ensure local solutions are properly integrated and optimized.

Regulatory awareness

  • Stay ahead of Banco Central regulations, PIX rulebook updates, Open Finance developments, and card scheme rules.
  • Translate regulatory changes into actionable internal recommendations and partner discussions.

Market intelligence

  • Continuously map the Brazilian payments landscape — tracking competitor capabilities, emerging payment trends, and new fintech entrants to inform Antom's local strategy.

What we're looking for

  • 5–8 years in payments, financial institutions partnerships, or payment operations within a fintech, bank, acquirer, payment processor, or global payments company — with a strong focus on the Brazilian market.
  • Deep, hands-on knowledge of Brazil's payment ecosystem: PIX, card acquiring, and Open Finance, including its regulatory framework and key institutional players.
  • Proven relationship management skills — ability to build and manage senior-level relationships with banks, acquirers, and payment institutions, including navigating complex contractual and operational discussions.
  • Operational mindset — comfortable owning KPIs and SLAs, troubleshooting payment issues with technical and partner teams, and driving measurable performance improvements.
  • Cross-functional communication — able to work across commercial, product, tech, and compliance teams, translating between business needs and technical requirements with ease.
  • Languages: Native Portuguese and full professional English proficiency.

Preferred qualifications

  • Prior experience at a global payments company, international acquirer, or cross-border payment platform operating in Brazil.
  • Existing network across Brazilian financial institutions, acquirers, and Open Finance participants.
  • Familiarity with API-based payment integrations and the technical fundamentals of payment processing.
  • A practical approach to AI tools — using them to automate routine tasks, accelerate analysis, and improve the quality and efficiency of your own work output.
  • MBA or advanced degree in Business, Finance, or a related field.
  • Mandarin is a strong plus.

About Antom

Antom is a leading merchant payment and digitisation services provider under Ant International. We help global merchants and partners accept digital payments, scale their businesses across borders, and deliver seamless checkout experiences to consumers worldwide. In Brazil, we are investing in the local payments ecosystem to become the infrastructure layer of choice for merchants operating in or into the market.

title: Senior Frontend Engineer
description:
Note: This role is 100% remote, but we require overlap with Eastern Time (EST/EDT) working hours to ensure smooth collaboration with the team.

Company Introduction

NextDay AI is a privately held company specializing in applying artificial intelligence (AI) engineering and creative innovation in B2C entertainment products. Our mission is to leverage the power of Large Language Models (LLM) and generative AI (Gen AI) to create innovative consumer products that push the boundaries of entertainment and companionship. With over 35 millions+ messages per day and millions of monthly visitors, our products are revolutionizing the way people interact with AI.

This is a unique opportunity to participate and make a real difference in a company actively working to shape the future of AI applications for consumers.

Job Description

We’re looking for a Senior Frontend Engineer who can own and drive the frontend experience across our web and mobile products. We need someone who sees problems, proposes solutions, and ships them. You’ll be working across a modern React (web) and React Native (mobile) codebase, building features used by millions of users every day.

You’ll care deeply about code quality, maintainability, and performance - and you’ll champion the use of AI-assisted and agentic coding tools to move faster without sacrificing standards. You’re the kind of engineer who treats AI coding assistants as a force multiplier, not a crutch, and you’re always looking for ways to improve code quality and performance with these tools.

This is a high-autonomy, high-impact role. You’ll collaborate closely with product, design, backend engineers, and QA - but at the end of the day, you’ll own your domain and be trusted to make the right calls.

What You’ll Do

  • Build, ship, and maintain high-quality features across our React web application and React Native mobile app, working across the full frontend surface area.
  • Take ownership of major frontend initiatives end-to-end - from technical design through implementation, testing, and deployment - without needing hand-holding.
  • Write clean, well-tested, maintainable TypeScript code that other engineers can confidently build on. Champion code quality standards, review PRs thoroughly, and help to raise the bar for the whole team.
  • Actively leverage AI-assisted coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or similar) and agentic workflows to accelerate development. Advocate for and help the team adopt best practices around AI-augmented engineering.
  • Collaborate with Product, Design, and QA to translate requirements into elegant, performant user experiences. Push back when something doesn’t make sense and propose better alternatives.
  • Improve our frontend architecture, patterns, and tooling. Identify technical debt and address it proactively - you don’t wait for permission to make things better.
  • Contribute to our shared business logic and component libraries, ensuring consistency across web and mobile platforms.
  • Mentor and support other engineers through code reviews, pairing sessions, and knowledge sharing. Lead by example.

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of professional frontend engineering experience with a strong track record of shipping production software at scale.
  • Deep expertise in React and the modern React ecosystem (hooks, context, routing, state management). You don’t just use React - you understand it.
  • Solid experience with React Native or strong willingness to ramp up quickly. We need someone comfortable building across both web and mobile.
  • Advanced TypeScript proficiency. You write typed code by default and understand how to use the type system to prevent bugs and improve developer experience.
  • A genuine passion for clean, maintainable code. You care about naming things well, keeping components focused, writing meaningful tests, and leaving code better than you found it.
  • Demonstrated experience with AI-assisted development tools and a clear point of view on how to use them effectively. You’re a champion of agentic coding workflows and can show how you’ve used them to ship faster.
  • Self-directed and proactive. You take initiative, own your work fully, and don’t need to be managed closely. You see what needs doing and do it.
  • Strong communication skills and a collaborative mindset. You can articulate technical decisions clearly to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, startup-like environment where priorities shift and ambiguity is the norm.

Nice to have

  • Familiarity with our tech stack:
  • React 18, React Native, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Redux Toolkit, Vitest, React Testing Library, GitHub Actions, Yarn 4
  • Experience with real-time features (Socket.io, WebSockets) and streaming interfaces
  • Experience building and consuming shared component libraries or design systems
  • Familiarity with feature flag systems (GrowthBook or similar) and progressive rollout strategies
  • Background in B2C consumer products with high traffic and millions of daily active users
  • Experience with PWA architecture, service workers, and offline-first patterns
  • Familiarity with the Atlassian suite (Jira, Confluence)
  • Interest or experience in AI/LLM products and conversational interfaces

Why join us?

  • Real 100% remote work (we don't have physical offices to go to "once per week")
  • Flex-time / Manage your schedule Policy (we are looking for teamwork and results, not hours)
  • Unlimited Vacations Policy
  • Competitive salary and benefits package.
  • A dynamic and supportive work environment.

If you're passionate about AI and innovation and want to be at the forefront of the conversational AI revolution and join a team on the first few years of a great journey, apply today! We might have a seat for you on our rocketship!

  • Wellhub
  • Vale alimentação e/ou refeição;
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados;
  • Kit office.

Somos um time de Profissionais Além da Conta!

A Aegea é a empresa líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Trabalhamos por um futuro sustentável, colocando nossa paixão na prática fazendo a diferença nos 507 municípios em que atuamos. Levamos saúde, qualidade de vida e dignidade para mais de aproximadamente 31 milhões de pessoas de norte a sul do Brasil. Empenhamos todos os esforços para contribuir com a sociedade por meio de inovações e serviços que vão além do tratamento e da distribuição de água e esgotamento sanitário. Nossa paixão é tornar cada dia melhor tanto o ambiente que oferecemos aos nossos colaboradores, bem como nos serviços que entregamos. Somos uma marca que pede licença para melhorar a vida da população de centenas de cidades, levando bem estar e prosperidade.

Nossos talentos são o que a Aegea Saneamento e suas concessionárias tem de único. Somos formados por mais de 19.000 colaboradores espalhados por diversos cantos do Brasil, levando soluções de saneamento eficiente e sob medida, respeitando as peculiaridades dos locais onde estamos presentes. Trabalhamos diariamente na construção de uma empresa eficiente, diversa, ética e sólida, buscando aprender e evoluir constantemente.

title: Pessoa Coordenadora de Qualidade
description:
Descrição da vaga

ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Gerenciar as Obras e reformas de lojas no shopping, garantindo que as obras sejam executadas de acordo com os padrões de qualidade estabelecidos e ocorram dentro do prazo programado;
  • Contribuir para a evolução da jornada do consumidor no Shopping, assegurando a aderência e a aplicação consistente dos padrões estabelecidos;
  • Coordenar a execução dos treinamentos de atendimento destinados a todos os colaboradores que atuam diretamente com o público;
  • Gerir o programa de reconhecimento voltado para o time de campo, equipes terceirizadas e orgânicas;
  • Coordenar projetos de reforma de ambientes internos do Shopping e supervisionar obras contratadas pela ALLOS;
  • Gerenciar e orientar equipe orgânica, garantindo que todos cumpram suas responsabilidades de forma eficaz;
  • Assegurar a manutenção dos padrões de ambiência do mall, por meio do acompanhamento contínuo de aspectos como limpeza, iluminação, sinalização e organização dos espaços comuns;
  • Atuar na identificação de oportunidades de melhoria na percepção de qualidade do shopping, propondo ajustes e ações que elevem a experiência do cliente no mall;

Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Ensino superior completo;
  • Conhecimento dos softwares AutoCAD e SketchUp;
  • Pacote Office avançado;
  • Habilidade em elaboração e gerenciamento de orçamento para a área;
  • Experiência prévia em funções relacionadas à gestão da qualidade e atendimento em shopping centers ou em setores similares;

Buscamos um Gerente de Engenharia de Plataforma para compor nosso time, na maior empresa de desenvolvimento de softwares e produtos para o mercado financeiro do Brasil, onde acreditamos que a inovação tecnológica inspira a evolução.

Esse cargo será responsável por:

  • Experiência em condução técnica de parceiros externos, incluindo definição de escopo, acompanhamento de entregas, governança de qualidade, critérios de aceite e transferência de conhecimento.

Caso possua o conhecimento ou atuação abaixo, será um diferencial:

title: Analista de Torre de Controle de Operações Pleno
description:
O Analista de Torre de Controle será responsável pelo monitoramento End-to-End da logística na Privalia. Com interface direta em toda a cadeia, seu papel é orquestrar ações corretivas imediatas para garantir a fluidez do fluxo de pedidos e o atingimento dos KPIs operacionais, indo muito além da simples observação dos processos.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Monitoramento em tempo real: Acompanhar o fluxo de pedidos e o status das etapas operacionais;
  • Interface Logística: Atuar como facilitador entre as áreas de Armazém, Transportes, Gestão de pedidos, S&OP e SAC, garantindo que a informação circule sem ruídos;
  • Gestão de Desvios: Identificar atrasos ou anomalias na operação e acionar prontamente as áreas responsáveis para mitigação de riscos;
  • Análise de KPIs: Monitorar indicadores críticos como On-Time Delivery (OTD) , Promessa de entrega e Lead Times de cada etapa;
  • Tendência de Performance: Simulação da performance operacional com base em históricos e tendências com impacto direto na cadeia;
  • Melhoria Contínua: Analisar a causa raiz de problemas recorrentes e propor soluções de processos ou tecnologia para otimizar a jornada do pedido;
  • Dashboards e Reports: Manter painéis de controle atualizados para suporte à tomada de decisão da liderança.

Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Formação: Ensino Superior completo em Engenharia, Administração, Logística ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência: Vivência prévia em operações de E-commerce, Logística ou Torres de Controle (Control Tower);
  • Habilidades Analíticas: Capacidade de ler dados complexos e transformá-los em planos de ação imediatos;
  • Ferramentas:
  • Excel/Google Sheets Avançado (essencial);
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de BI (Power BI, Looker, SQL, Python);
  • Soft Skills: Senso de urgência apurado, excelente comunicação interpessoal para lidar com diferentes níveis hierárquicos e resiliência para trabalhar em um ambiente de alto volume;
  • Diferenciais: Conhecimento em metologias Lean ou Six Sigma.

title: Technical Product Owner
description:
ABOUT US

, part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data.

Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy.

Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.

Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.

THE ROLE

We are seeking a highly technical and execution‑driven Technical Product Owner to serve as the “engine room” of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‑level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‑native, AI‑driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the “Golden Record” through seamless end‑to‑end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance.

What You’ll Do

  • Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions.
  • Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios.
  • UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‑class workflows within SKP.
  • Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‑functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value.
  • Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define “What Good Looks Like.” Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‑world user behavior.
  • Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage.

WHAT IT TAKES

  • The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure).
  • The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance “plumbing.” Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus.
  • The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication.
  • The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‑zone teams.
  • The Academic: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience.
  • The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams.

Key Skills

  • Visionary Leadership: Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals.
  • Advanced Governance Concepts: Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules.
  • AI/ML Application: Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‑matching or data‑cleansing logic.
  • Visual Communication: Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment.
  • Technical Storyboarding: Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity.
  • Relationship Orchestration: Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement.
  • Drive for Results: Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‑moving environment.

Be fully aligned with our core values:

Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have.

Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.

Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.

Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.

By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process.

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing.
  • Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.
  • Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone.
  • Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating, with each depicting a different journey, and we want to hear them all.
  • Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them.
  • An open organisation. Hierarchies are not our thing, and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone’s work is seen, and ideas are valued.

OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION

At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team.

We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

title: Ruby on Rails Developer
description:
Senior Software Engineer I, L3 Messaging Team (Remote)

We're recruiting a Senior Software Engineer I to own the technical direction of a mission-critical messaging platform serving hundreds of healthcare organizations across the United States.

THE ROLE

Our client is a fast-growing, mission-driven organization transforming patient engagement at scale. They've built the leading platform powering communications for underserved populations, with proven impact reaching millions. Now they're looking for a seasoned backend engineer to lead their Messaging Team technical direction and mentor the next generation of engineering talent.

You'll own complex features end-to-end, drive architectural decisions that shape how millions of patient communications are delivered, and share team lead responsibilities with your peers. This is a highly visible, technically autonomous role with direct impact on health equity outcomes.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 5+ years hands-on backend engineering with Ruby on Rails at scale
  • Deep experience building, maintaining, and scaling APIs and distributed systems
  • Advanced SQL skills and comfort working with large, complex datasets
  • Proven ability to independently own complex projects end-to-end and mentor junior engineers
  • Data-driven mindset you rely on evidence, not intuition
  • Excellent communicator (especially in fully remote environments)
  • Passionate about mission-driven work and advancing health equity

BONUS POINTS

  • Experience with Twilio, RCS, or MMS messaging platforms
  • Familiarity with healthcare compliance (TCPA, consent workflows, carrier regulations)
  • Tech stack: React, PostgreSQL, Google Cloud, Sidekiq
  • Event-driven architecture or high-throughput message delivery pipelines

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Own and drive the technical direction of key messaging platform features
  • Design and build backend messaging systems (delivery pipelines, consent management, scheduling orchestration, API integrations)
  • Mentor L2 engineers, lead technical design discussions, and set engineering standards
  • Contribute to architectural decisions that shape messaging infrastructure at scale
  • Participate in on-call rotations (PagerDuty) and help improve team processes
  • Work cross-functionally with Product, Customer Success, and Data teams

YOUR IMPACT

  • Month 1: Master the platform architecture and contribute to technical design discussions
  • Month 3: Independently deliver complex features with meaningful impact on patient outcomes
  • Month 6: Be recognized as a technical leader driving strategic initiatives across the engineering department

description:

Apply

title: Promotor(a) Técnico(a) Comercial | Animais de Companhia | Rio de Janeiro
description:
Com foco na saúde animal, a Virbac é uma indústria farmacêutica veterinária de matriz Francesa. Atuante em mais de 100 países ao redor do mundo.

Os produtos abrangem mais de 50 espécies, com uma de produtos e serviços que permite diagnosticar, prevenir e tratar a maioria das patologias. Comprometidos diariamente em melhorar a qualidade de vida dos animais e em moldar juntos o futuro da saúde animal.

title: Implementation Analyst
description:
Job Title: Implementation Analyst

English Resume Only

Location: Brazil

Type: Full-Time Contract

Setup: Fully Remote

Level: Mid-Level

Industry: Software SAAS Company

Shift: US Hours

Start Date: can start in 2 weeks after offer

Equipment: Available upon request

Rate: R$8,000 - R$10,000

About The Methodical Group

The Methodical Group (methodicalgroup.com) is a leading global provider of IT Services, Consulting, and Specialized Staffing Solutions, operating with a systematic, high-quality approach for over 25 years. Headquartered in St. Petersburg, Florida, we use proprietary frameworks, such as ExactTalent®, to provide specialized workforce solutions, including permanent placement and contract staffing, across industries such as IT and Healthcare. Simultaneously, our IT and Business Services division offers expert solutions in Software Development, Data & Analytics, and IT Operations, aiming to help organizations worldwide drive digital transformation, improve efficiency, and maintain a competitive edge.

About the Opportunity

Our client is seeking an Implementation Analyst to support their Professional Services team, leading end-to-end deployments of a SaaS platform across municipal government clients. This role combines project leadership, client engagement, and product expertise—guiding customers through configuration, setup, data migration, and training to ensure successful system adoption.

The Implementation Analyst will work closely with clients to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable system solutions, ensuring each customer realizes measurable value while delivering a seamless and high-quality onboarding experience.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the full implementation lifecycle for new customers, from kickoff through go-live, managing multiple concurrent implementations for small-to-mid-sized municipal clients.
  • Conduct discovery sessions to gather business requirements, workflows, and success metrics, translating them into system configurations.
  • Configure and customize the SaaS platform based on client-specific use cases while maintaining best practices and scalability.
  • Coordinate with Data Engineers on data imports and integrations, performing QA testing to validate functionality and data integrity prior to go-live.
  • Deliver customer training sessions to ensure user adoption and proficiency across departments.
  • Monitor project timelines, proactively managing scope, risks, dependencies, and overall project health.
  • Document configurations, implementation decisions, and knowledge base materials to support consistency and scalability.
  • Collaborate with Product, Support, and Customer Success teams to ensure smooth transition and ongoing client success post-launch.
  • Identify opportunities for process improvement and recommend best practices to optimize future implementations.

Qualifications

  • At least 2 years of Professional Services or Implementation experience supporting Enterprise SaaS products.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • Strong understanding of SaaS platforms, cloud environments, and data management principles.
  • Working knowledge of data concepts such as file formats, field mapping, and data validation, with the ability to coordinate effectively with technical teams.
  • Experience using tools such as Wrike, HubSpot, Salesforce, Jira, or similar implementation and project tracking platforms.
  • Proven experience working directly with clients and managing multiple implementation projects simultaneously.
  • Ability to manage client relationships professionally, set expectations, and communicate effectively throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Strong ability to translate technical concepts into clear, business-friendly language.
  • Excellent problem-solving, analytical, communication, organizational, and time-management skills.
  • Ability to quickly learn new technologies, tools, and business domains.
